description: Precommitted lower control for the 3dp-ceil-versus-float damage discriminator. WIP attacks with 875 T6 Infantry and no heroes; minxxx defends with 26 T6 Infantry and 875 T6 Marksmen and no heroes. Both the current per-attack 3dp ceiling and an otherwise identical full-float counterfactual predict minxxx wins with exactly 679 Marksmen surviving.
